key_insight: The paper establishes the first per-worker convergence guarantees for decentralized learning that directly minimizes the original GDRO objective: the maximum local risk.
engineering_relevance: Networked workers can train locally available robust models without relying on an unavailable globally averaged model.
method: Decompose semi-decentralized GDRO into decentralized online convex optimization and prediction with expert advice.
Decompose fully decentralized GDRO into two coupled decentralized online convex optimization problems.
Isolate consensus errors to support modular communication routines, including accelerated gossip and Choco-gossip.
evidence_signal: Theoretical instantiations achieve O(sqrt(log(m)/T)) convergence over T update rounds, and experiments report improved worst-worker performance over baselines.
watch_item: Practical performance depends on controlling disagreement among workers; the abstract does not quantify communication costs or experimental gains.
paper_title: Group Distributionally Robust Optimization over Decentralized Networks
